title: Dead and Buried
start: Talk to the Raptor north of the guardhouse in Fort Forinthry.

ironman.t: 50 Woodcutting (to chop acadia logs for the planks)

items.t: 24 limestone bricks to make stone wall segments
168 acadia planks to make acadia frames

kills.t: Three material ghouls, which scale to your combat level
22 the Nightmares, which scale to your combat level
10 fetid zombies, which scale to your combat level

rewards.t: 3000 Skill XP lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
Ability to build all three tiers of the Fort Forinthry Ranger's Workroom.

steps.t: Talk to the Raptor in Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Dead and Buried'. › Accept]
Continue with the portal in front of the Town Hall to enter. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the Herald of Varrock. [Chat: ~ › ~ › ~ › 4 (Conclude interview.) › 1 Yes, I've asked enough questions.]
Talk to Bill. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Dead and Buried'.]
Check plans on the Fort Forinthry blueprints and select Ranger's Workroom (Tier 1).
Build the Ranger's Workroom in the south-west near the Guardhouse.
Talk to guard captain Sofía in the newly-built Ranger's Workroom.
Talk to the Raptor. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Dead and Buried'.]
Continue with the portal by the Wilderness crypt entrance outside the northern gate.
Talk to the Raptor.
Collect six out of nine materials from the six spooky holes in the western room.

sub.t: Kill the three material ghouls that spawn to collect the last three materials.

steps.t: Construct the bridge near the Raptor.
Cross the bridge and investigate the ancient door.
Push either of the two pillars. Switch to the Raptor and push the other pillar to unlock the door.
Search the ancient door to receive the dragonkin device.
Speak to the Raptor.
Go to the Varrock Library and continue with the portal by the entrance. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Reldo for a potion of dreamless sleep.
p: The man and woman are killed in the fire.

steps.t: Drink the potion, then inspect the dragonkin device to enter the dream. [Chat: 1 Enter dream.]

The aim is to step on the pressure plates, unlock all the boulders, and enter the final barrier. As the player, you can push and pull boulders one tile at a time. As the Raptor, you can push boulders five tiles, and pull by one tile.

sub.t: It might glitch and not show the boulder, although it is there and interactable.
For rooms that don't have enough boulders, you need to step on a pressure plate to spawn one.

steps.t: Player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Pull and push the boulder to the middle plate outside boulder gate 2.
The player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Pull and push both boulders to the outer pressure plates at boulder gate 3.
The player steps on a pressure plate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the other pressure plate.
Walk through to boulder gate 4.
The player steps on either of the two furthest pressure plates from the gate. This creates a boulder.
Switch to the Raptor and push the boulder to any pressure plate next to the gate.
Repeat for the other pressure plate.
The player steps on the pressure plate by the gate.
Switch to the Raptor and step on the pressure plate by the gate.
Walk through.
The Raptor steps on the western-most pressure plate.
The player pulls the boulder and pushes it to the second pressure plate (going clockwise).
The player steps on the third pressure plate, and the second boulder appears.

sub.t: If the second boulder does not spawn, exit to the lobby and continue again with the portal at the library.

steps.t: The player pushes and pulls the boulder to the fourth pressure plate.
The player steps on the third pressure plate to open the gate.
Run to the strange girl to start a cutscene.
Go through all the chat options, then delve deeper into the dream.
Interact with the dim light.
Lower the health of the Nightmares as the player, then swap to the Raptor to deal the finishing blow.

sub.t: Currently this part is glitched if you are in a group, which will prevent the player from progressing as expected. Simply leaving the group and re-entering the instance will allow progress.

steps.t: Interact with the pillar of light and talk with the character that appears.
Continue on the path, and repeat the same process with the dim lights along the way.
Finally, speak to the Raptor that appears.
Read the ancient writings on the wall at the end of the path.
Finish talking to the Raptor, then go back to the crypt in the Wilderness.
Continue with the portal in front of the crypt.
Enter the ancient door, then investigate the map table in the central room.
Kill fetid zombies around the crypt and collect 10 map pieces. Do not leave the crypt.
Deposit onto the map table to start the puzzle.
Complete the map (shown below) using the same strategy as for solving a puzzle box or Wp | sliding puzzle , strategy guide here.

sub.t: Speaking to the Raptor to turn on accessibility mode is advised; this will highlight tiles while they are in the correct position.

steps.t: Finish the following dialogue with the Raptor before continuing.
p: The completed slider puzzle (oriented with north at the top).

steps.t: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre back at Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 2 Talk about quests.]
Talk to the Raptor to finish the quest.

p: Pushing a boulder in the Raptor's dream.
